name: Black Bean Dip with Feta & Bell Pepper "Chips"

instructions.primary_message: This recipe will make about 4 cups of bean dip. Work in batches to best fit your blender or food processor.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro
5 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the onion and garlic. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and jalapeño; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice limes into a blender.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the blender along with water and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans black beans
⅓ cup water
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the sautéed veggies are soft, add to the blender. Blend on high until semi-smooth, adding more water, 1-2 tablespoons at a time, if needed.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the blender and process once more until just combined. Set aside.
Cut bell peppers lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Slice each quarter crosswise into 3-4 pieces to make the "chips."
Divide black bean dip between plates and sprinkle with feta. Serve with bell pepper "chips" on the side.
